verdict.rationale: Netlify's own copy states "Auto-deploy on every push" with a preview URL for every PR, plus Deploy Previews for reviewing changes before they go live. Independent users corroborate this: the GitHub integration with automated builds and deploys "works great," and PR preview builds are called a killer feature. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Git-connected deploy setup (supported Git providers, branch and build configuration) rather than one-line marketing claims.
